biggest_catch: The €3 is real and immediate, but you cannot touch it until your balance reaches €10 — the bonus alone is not withdrawable.
catches: The €3 welcome bonus is offered at signup (shown on the official referral signup page).
You may request a payout only once your balance reaches €10.
Payout options per official site: bank transfer, PayPal, Amazon gift voucher, or eBuyCard.
One bonus per person; adults resident in France.
Cashback rates and partner offers vary; the bonus counts toward the €10 threshold.

eligibility: New EbuyClub members; adults resident in France. Bonus shown when signing up (referral signup page shows '3€ offerts').
maximize: Sign up via a referral link so the €3 lands in your balance immediately, then buy discounted gift cards (bons d'achat) for supermarkets you already use — EbuyClub credits the cashback on gift-card purchases instantly, which stacks your balance toward the €10 payout threshold fastest. Check the app before grocery runs for receipt-cashback offers too.
notes: DEMOTED by coordinator adjudication 2026-09-23: France-only cashback portal - US users cannot earn. The catalog serves US users; a route requiring foreign residency/bank cannot be acted on. Real program, wrong audience. Original: €3 ≈ $3.24 at ~€1 = $1.08 (basis stated). Not in the existing Upmore catalog — EbuyClub (founded 1999, 3,000+ partners, Plebicom) is France's other major cashback portal alongside iGraal and fills a regional gap. Distinct from R7305 (iGraal): different company, different bonus, lower €10 threshold.

steps: Sign up for EbuyClub (the referral signup page shows '3€ offerts').
The €3 welcome bonus is credited to your balance.
Earn cashback on shopping (online, in-store receipts, or gift-card purchases) until your balance reaches €10.
Request payout via bank transfer or PayPal (also Amazon voucher or eBuyCard).
timing: €3 credited at signup; payout requestable once the balance reaches €10, via bank transfer or PayPal.
